description: Focused follow-up after green branch CI: close one Vertex scenario-run terminal-state gap so upper-layer stream fallback behavior matches the mounted polling contract.

userStories.title: Emit canceled Vertex scenario-run stream fallback events
userStories.problem: Vertex scenario-run polling treats canceled runs as terminal, but the guarded stream helper's REST fallback returns null for canceled records after reconnect exhaustion. A caller using the stream fallback can end without learning that the run was canceled.
userStories.userStory: As a Vertex operator watching a scenario run, I want a canceled run to surface as a terminal stream event so the UI can stop waiting and show the operator cancellation state.
bddAcceptance: Given the scenario-run stream reconnect path exhausts retries and the REST fallback returns status canceled with a run RID and error, when pollFinalState resolves, then it emits a terminal canceled RunEvent carrying the run RID and error.
Given an SSE message arrives with kind canceled, when openScenarioRunStream handles it, then the async iterator yields that canceled event and closes the EventSource.
Given the REST fallback returns pending or running, when pollFinalState resolves, then it still returns null because those statuses are non-terminal.
Given the TypeScript SDK polling path waits for scenario runs, when its existing canceled-run test runs, then it still treats canceled as a terminal lifecycle record.
